versions.note: First release: TAF Timeline v1.25 (left, 66 %) and LOOME Night Ops v1.7 (right, 34 %) merged into one page, each scoped to its own pane; tabs below 1100 px; installable and offline; WeatherDashboard icon.
LOOME side updated to v1.8 (nearest large or medium airport within 10 NM names the place). TAF unchanged (v1.25).
Top bar with a light/dark switch (opens in dark, remembers the choice); high-legibility light theme for both sides; TAF airport cards always one per row. TAF v1.25 and LOOME v1.8 unchanged.

New Vessels section (v1.0): search the curated vessel list by name or MMSI, view photos from the ais-photos repo, and upload new photos (resized on the device, credit required, shared upload code) via /api/vessel-photo. Own tab below 1100 px, below the TAF timeline on wide screens. TAF v1.25 and LOOME v1.8 unchanged.

Light theme: petrol accent (#27535C) replaces brown across TAF, LOOME and Vessels (titles, labels, selected mode, AIP warning); amber fills unchanged. Selected mode frame follows the switch's rounded corners (both themes). Vessels v1.1: space below the section, search field scrolls to the top when used, full-screen photo viewer (wheel/pinch zoom, drag, double-click/tap reset, Esc/✕ to close).

Version number in the header (LOOME footer line removed). TAF Timeline v1.26: Edit aerodromes has ✕ to remove (with Undo) and the add/search field. Vessels v1.2: MMSI required only for vessels without one, Find MMSI from AIS with picker, MMSI format check (2–7 + 8 digits), hard stop on name/MMSI mismatch with Use AIS name, Upload anyway when MMSI not in AIS, no duplicate MMSIs, Add as separate / Go to existing for same name, vessel type in results. Requires api/vessel-photo.js v1.1.

Vessels v1.3: live traffic map (OpenStreetMap + OpenSeaMap, coloured ship icons rotated to course, grey 5 px vectors and turn curves, layer panel with categories and overlays, tap a vessel for details and photos). Vessel card shows position age, SOG/COG, destination and ETA, plus a mini-map that expands to the full map. Wide screens: Vessels is full width below TAF and LOOME (the page scrolls down to it); phones keep the Vessels tab, with the map opening full screen. Requires AIS Worker 1.5 (/live.json).

Vessels v1.4: opening a vessel in the search (tap, or Enter with one match) centres the live map on it, rings it and opens its info box (full-screen map on phones). Vessels without an MMSI are looked up by exact name in AIS for position and map focus. Info box restyled (dark, readable; light theme supported). Requires AIS Worker 1.7 (/live.json?name=).

Wide screens scroll as one page (fixes iPad scrolling). 'Vessels ↓' button next to the flight-rules switch. Vessels v1.5: heading 'Vessel Information'; map refresh every 30 s; ship icons drawn on canvas from zoom 7; vessel names + speed from zoom 9 (switchable); 2 px vectors; Stations layer (dark blue stars with names); ETA to point (dynamic line + ETA label, kept until removed); station ETA for tankers, rigs and heavy-lift (Mongstad → Holmengrå, Sture → Fedje vest, else nearest); Save MMSI for listed vessels found by name in AIS. Requires api/vessel-photo.js with the setMmsi action.

Vessels v1.6: all vessel ETAs (ETA to point, station ETA, AIS ETA) in Norwegian local time, e.g. 15:42 LT, with automatic summer/winter time. Destination → station also by UN/LOCODE: NO MON / Mongstad → Holmengrå, NO STU / Sture → Fedje vest, NO KAR / Kårstø → Skudefjorden, NO MLK / Melkøya → Fruholmen (spaces, hyphens and case ignored).
